## What and why

Link the issue (`Fixes #N`) and say what this changes.

## Evidence

For a skill or template change: how you used it, with a link to a public PR, CI run or log where possible.

## Checks

- [ ] `python scripts/check_repo.py` prints `OK`
- [ ] Relative links still resolve and skill frontmatter `name` matches its folder
- [ ] No tokens, private transcripts or personal data in the diff

Report only the checks you actually ran, and say if AI tools helped write this PR.
